sources.title: Mistral 7B v0.3 official model documentation
sources.evidence: Version 0.3 is dated May 22, 2024. Its Instruct Weights row links to this exact repository and separately labels Parameters (B) as 7 and Active (B) as 7. The row also lists Apache 2.0 and 32k context. The hosted model is now retired; this does not withdraw its released weights.

sources.title: Mistral 7B v0.3 official documentation, Markdown
sources.evidence: Explicit release_date 2024-05-22, version 0.3, input text, output text, 32k context, open/generalist classification, Apache 2.0, and an Instruct Weights link to this exact checkpoint.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 official model card
sources.evidence: Names the exact instruction fine-tune of Mistral-7B-v0.3, identifies the Mistral AI team and Apache-2.0 license, provides public weight download instructions, and explicitly documents function calling using the v3 tokenizer. Contains native mistral-inference and Transformers tool-call examples. It does not establish a dedicated reasoning mode.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: MistralForCausalLM with 32 layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 14336, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, vocabulary 32768, max_position_embeddings 32768, sliding_window null, BF16 and tie_word_embeddings false.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 native configuration
sources.evidence: Specifies dim 4096, 32 layers, head_dim 128, hidden_dim 14336, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads and vocabulary 32768; supplies neither MoE nor vision settings to the official loader.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 full checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps exactly 291 distinct weight tensors to three shards and declares 14,496,047,104 tensor bytes. The complete index was checked against all three bounded shard headers, including every key and shard assignment.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 model-00001-of-00003.safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only the 8-byte prefix and 11,224-byte JSON header with validated HTTP 206 ranges. Contains 97 BF16 learned weight tensors totaling 2,474,721,280 elements. Shapes match contiguous offsets and the complete file size; no quantization scales or buffers appear. All indexed names and shard assignments match.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 model-00002-of-00003.safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only the 8-byte prefix and 12,352-byte JSON header with validated HTTP 206 ranges. Contains 106 BF16 learned weight tensors totaling 2,499,903,488 elements. Shapes match contiguous offsets and the complete file size; no quantization scales or buffers appear. All indexed names and shard assignments match.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 model-00003-of-00003.safetensors header
sources.evidence: Read only the 8-byte prefix and 10,224-byte JSON header with validated HTTP 206 ranges. Contains 88 BF16 learned weight tensors totaling 2,273,398,784 elements. Shapes match contiguous offsets and the complete file size; no quantization scales or buffers appear. All indexed names and shard assignments match.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 native checkpoint header
sources.evidence: Read only the 8-byte prefix and 31,400-byte JSON header with validated HTTP 206 ranges. All 291 BF16 tensors total 7,248,023,552 learned weights and 14,496,047,104 data bytes. Complete offsets plus header account for the 14,496,078,512-byte file. Includes separate input embedding and output matrices, 32 sets of dense attention/MLP weights and learned norms; no buffers, quantization metadata or expert routers. This independently agrees with all three Transformers shards.

sources.title: Mistral inference Transformer arguments
sources.evidence: TransformerArgs defaults moe, lora and vision_encoder to None. The exact checkpoint params therefore select an ordinary dense text Transformer, not optional MoE or vision modules.

sources.title: Mistral inference attention, dense MLP and normalization implementation
sources.evidence: TransformerBlock uses FeedForward when moe is None; its three bias-free matrices implement a SiLU-gated dense MLP. Attention uses four bias-free projections with grouped KV heads; both layer norms are learned RMSNorm weights. This accounts for the native tensor names and shapes.

sources.title: Mistral inference model and checkpoint loader
sources.evidence: Transformer.from_folder loads params.json into TransformerArgs. Transformer constructs separate input embedding and output linear modules, all configured decoder layers and a final learned norm; vision modules require an explicit vision configuration. These modules account for every tensor in the native header.

sources.title: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 official chat template
sources.evidence: Defines text chat serialization plus AVAILABLE_TOOLS, TOOL_CALLS and TOOL_RESULTS branches and requires nine-character tool-call IDs. The current template has no reasoning-mode parameter or dedicated thinking channel; that absence alone does not prove a negative reasoning capability.

sources.title: Official Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 repository chronology
sources.evidence: Initial commit is May 22, 2024 at 09:57 UTC and upload 7B instruct is May 22 at 10:16 UTC. This corroborates the explicit first-party release date; repository creation alone is not being treated as the release announcement. Later template updates do not change the original release date.

name.note: Official card identifies this exact Instruct v0.3 checkpoint; spaces normalize the published hyphenated name.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the card, checkpoint and official documentation; Mistral is the existing normalized developer name.

family.note: Exact card identifies Mistral-7B-v0.3 as the base model; configuration declares model_type mistral.

release_date.note: The version 0.3 official documentation explicitly dates this release May 22, 2024 and links the exact Instruct checkpoint. Same-day public weight-upload history corroborates it. Day precision is supported.

open_weights.note: Official public download instructions and accessible native/Transformers checkpoints establish open weights independently of the retired hosted endpoint.

license.note: Exact official Instruct weights row and repository license metadata both specify Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned-parameter count: 7,248,023,552 / 1e9. All 291 BF16 tensors in all three indexed shards and the independent native checkpoint agree; every index key, shard assignment, shape, byte offset and full-file boundary was checked. Official module definitions show these are learned embeddings, dense attention/MLP matrices and norms, without buffers, packed weights or scale metadata. Input and output embeddings are untied and both counted. Formula: 2*32768*4096 + 32*(2*4096*4096 + 2*4096*1024 + 3*4096*14336 + 2*4096) + 4096. No full weight payload was downloaded.

active_parameters_b.note: The official v0.3 page separately reports Active (B) = 7 in the row linking this exact Instruct checkpoint. Preserve this nominal reported precision; it is not an exact active count and is not inferred by equating dense total and active parameters.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with grouped-query attention and gated dense MLPs. The exact native configuration selects moe=None in official code, and all 32 layers have ordinary dense projections with no router or expert tensors. No architecture details are transferred from v0.1 or v0.2.

context_window.note: Exact v0.3 configuration sets max_position_embeddings to 32768, agreeing with the official 32k context label. This is the declared supported window, not the vocabulary size or an inherited earlier-version limit.

modalities.note: Exact official Markdown documentation explicitly lists text input and text output; the checkpoint contains a text-token decoder without vision/audio components.

reasoning.note: Checked exact official documentation, card, template and targeted first-party searches. No explicit native reasoning-mode or non-reasoning declaration was found for this checkpoint. Generalist labeling, ordinary prompt-following and absence of thinking markers do not establish a negative capability. Clear the unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact v0.3 card explicitly adds function calling and demonstrates native tool schemas through the v3 tokenizer; the official template supports tool calls and results. This is native checkpoint support, not an external agent wrapper or a capability inferred from v0.2.

description.value: Open 7B Mistral instruction model with function calling
description.note: All factual claims are supported. 7B is the official nominal model designation; the numeric parameter field now supplies the exact full-checkpoint count.

patch.notes: Total parameters count all 291 learned BF16 tensors: 7,248,023,552. Mistral separately reports a nominal 7B active; this is not an exact active count. Native reasoning support remains unverified.

summary: Replaced the name-derived 7B total with a complete 7.248023552B learned-parameter count, independently verified from all indexed BF16 shards and the native checkpoint. Added the separately published nominal 7B active count and verified dense Transformer architecture. Confirmed May 22, 2024 release, Apache 2.0 open weights, 32768-token context, text modalities and native function calling. Cleared unsupported reasoning=false to unverified null. No specifications were borrowed from earlier Mistral 7B revisions.
